reason: Use the measured progress-aware carrier, whose whole-concept relation labels survive on 18 of 24 observed questions, with token-progress coordinates; require native-negative separation before fact writing.
formula: Equalize mean squared energy of the twelve relation and thirty-two progress coordinates on the fifty earlier questions. Whiten the joint coordinates with native second moment plus .05 mean-variance isotropic term. For each relation/previous-token cell, use its mean direction; require separation from all native states and different-token factual fit states. Realize a bounded ramp with paired SiLU gates and the previously checked negative-anchor subtraction. Whiten the relation and progress blocks separately. Normalize each direction to unit response at its own cell mean, then average the two directions; the progress mean uses every fit state with the same preceding token.
coverage_note: A saturated paired-SiLU predicate equals the squared anchor, not one. Coverage here reports both the earlier absolute threshold and saturation relative to that known factor.
